message.content: The last common ancestor of the clade **Laurasiatheria**—the group that includes all modern carnivores (like lions) and odd‑toed ungulates (like zebras). This ancestor lived roughly 100 million years ago and gave rise to the diverse lineages that eventually led to the lion’s family Felidae and the zebra’s family Equidae.
